target.name: Next-year gross tree-cover-loss fraction
target.definition: Area of independently reviewed stand-replacement tree-cover loss during the next full calendar year, divided by independently documented tree-covered area at the prediction cutoff, within a fixed study patch.
target.intended_use: Compare annual loss forecasts on protected places and later years; prioritize subsequent investigation.
target.reference_protocol: Independent dated baseline forest mask and loss-area assessment for the identical footprint/window; full baseline-mask coverage; recorded uncertainty and human review. Annual products retain annual time precision.
target.forest_definition: Trees taller than 5 metres and at least 30 percent canopy cover, documented by an independent baseline reference; plantations and natural forests must be distinguished in study metadata.
